alerts.title: West Suburban Medical Center — Permanently Closed
alerts.description: West Suburban Medical Center has permanently closed all services including its emergency department. 23,000+ patients displaced.

alerts.title: BREAKING: Loretto Hospital Cuts ER to Daytime Only
alerts.description: Loretto Hospital has announced it is reducing emergency department hours to 7 AM - 7 PM effective immediately, citing critical staffing shortages after absorbing West Suburban's patient overflow. Austin now has ZERO overnight emergency care within 4 miles.

alerts.title: Community Response: 3 Churches Offer Overnight Screening
alerts.description: Austin Community Coalition announces 3 churches will open their community halls as overnight health screening and triage sites (7 PM - 7 AM), staffed by volunteer nurses and community health workers. Sites: Greater Mt. Zion (5765 W Midway Park), Austin Town Hall (5610 W Lake St), New Mt. Pilgrim (4301 W Washington Blvd).
